purpose: Remove the fixed present-day40coin restriction before further strategy qualification; collect official archive-observed daily history including no-longer-current contracts. Data acquisition and eligibility only, no return selection or new alpha claim.
market: Binance USD-M perpetual candidates whose archive directory matches uppercase alphanumeric USDT suffix; dated contracts excluded
current_metadata_policy: Binance connector exchangeInfo is a capture-time snapshot only. Its absent symbols must not be discarded. Known current non-COIN underlying types are labelled separately; unknown historical asset types remain explicit. Current metadata is not historical status or delisting certification.
catalog_policy: Enumerate root with delimiter and every NextMarker until IsTruncated=false. Enumerate each matching contract1d directory the same way; select only actual YYYY-MM archives whose calendar lies in the frozen interval. Pair every ZIP with its published CHECKSUM. Never construct an assumed missing month as zero data.
ingestion_policy: Download exact catalog keys, require official SHA256, archive CRC and one expected CSV basename. Parse numeric UTC timestamps explicitly; enforce actual UTC1d starts and month bounds. Preserve missing interior days, listing-boundary partial candles, zero volume, malformed OHLC, duplicate timestamps and absent adjacent months as explicit quality issues rather than impute or forward-fill them.
eligibility_policy: Use only completed prior daily observations and full consecutive28day quote history at each decision. Do not require survival to the evaluation end. No synthetic prices after final archive bar; full intraday executions, historical contract status, final settlement and fees must be obtained and verified separately before accounts. The preview does not prove exact live tradability.

research_sources.role: inspect dynamic archive universe and tail-clipping limitations; source claim not independently verified
inspect weekly pure funding carry and positive/negative evidence; spot-proxy results and missing public raw data cannot substitute for our accounts
